structured.answer: With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years and nothing at the start, the page says I'd put in 135,000 ₪ and end up with about 179,889 ₪ in today's money. It assumes 7% a year growth and 2% inflation a year. The cheapest place it shows is an account at Pesagot (פסגות) with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500", costing 2,604 ₪ over 15 years against 11,643 ₪ at Leumi. I'd check with my son before moving anything.
